artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan covering scope items A-E: scratch-tree reproduction, category shape survey, generalized allow-list post-filter anchored on subdir, zero-result wipeout detector, regression spec, and one deliberate redeploy.

memory_candidates.content: When generalizing a category-specific special case in a scan/filter loop, anchor the generalized pattern on the argument that names the ACTUAL scanned path segment (the subdir), not on the argument that names the logical category (filter_category). In the nvim picker sync's sync_scan(), those two arguments are equal at 6 of 7 call sites but diverge at one: OpenCode passes agents_subdir='agent/subagents' with filter_category='agents'. Anchoring on the logical category would build a pattern that cannot match the real path, silently dropping every file in that category -- a new instance of the exact defect being fixed. Pair the generalized match with a fallback to the prior narrower rule when the match fails, so a future divergent call site degrades to old behavior instead of wiping the category, and add a total-wipeout detector (#results>0 and #filtered==0) so any such silent drop becomes visible.
